description:
SOURCE: hardening pass 2026-05-29 (multi-layer sync discipline added to CLAUDE.md + steward task).
WHY: walkthrough content lives in 3 layers (beat_scripts.md prose / walkthrough_html/beat<N>.html visual / SKILL.md nav) that can silently drift. The hazard may already have bitten before the discipline existed.
TASK: across all 5 walkthrough skills (overview, as-memory, as-bus, for-meta-analysis, for-decisions) verify each beat's prose in beat_scripts.md matches its walkthrough_html/beat<N>.html and its SKILL.md one-line summary. (overview has beat2_everyone.html + beat2_coder.html.)
ACCEPTANCE: a per-skill per-beat sync report posted as a comment; any drift found is fixed in-place or spun off as its own child ticket (with all affected layers enumerated).
title: Verify walkthrough layer-sync (beat_scripts <-> HTML <-> SKILL) across 5 skills
